research_question: Calculate long-term summer monthly mean streamflow statistics for a continuous-record streamgage on Otter Creek in Acadia National Park.

phase_1.user_prompt: I am evaluating baseline summer streamflow conditions on Mount Desert Island in eastern coastal Maine. I need to find the USGS continuous-record streamgage on Otter Creek near Bar Harbor and retrieve its daily discharge data for the 15-year period from 2006 through 2020.

phase_2.user_prompt: Now that we have identified the Otter Creek streamgage, please download its daily mean discharge data for the continuous 15-year period over the 15 calendar years beginning in 2006.

phase_3.user_prompt: Process the daily streamflow data to compute the long-term monthly mean and median discharge for the summer months (May, June, July, August, September). To do this, pool all the daily values for a given month across all 15 years, and calculate the overall mean and median for that month.

phase_4.user_prompt: Based on your aggregated statistics, what is the computed long-term monthly mean discharge for August at the Otter Creek streamgage?
